args: WITH receipt(product_sku, qty) AS (VALUES ('ABC-1234',2)) SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.product_name, pv.price_cents, pv.price_currency, r.qty, pv.record_path FROM receipt r JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_sku = r.product_sku;

WITH receipt(product_sku, qty, old_unit_cents) AS (VALUES ('ABC-1234',2,549)) SELECT SUM(r.qty * r.old_unit_cents) AS old_total_cents, SUM(r.qty * pv.price_cents) AS today_total_cents, ABS(SUM(r.qty * pv.price_cents) - SUM(r.qty * r.old_unit_cents)) AS diff_cents FROM receipt r JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_sku = r.product_sku;
